summary: The filing is a routine 8-K by TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund, a non-traded BDC, disclosing monthly distributions declared on August 27, 2026, for Class I, S, and D shares (net per-share amounts $0.2000, $0.1818, $0.1947), payable September 28, 2026. It also reports NAV per share of $25.1986 for all classes as of July 31, 2026, aggregate NAV of $2.8 billion, and offering proceeds of $2.84 billion to date. No special situation is involved; this is standard regulatory disclosure.
